Alex (AE): Quick heads-up — Horizon Labs wants a short POC next week. They need the JS SDK for live streaming + function/tool calls and structured JSON output. Also asked about SSO + KMS for credentials and a rough estimate for token cost. Who can help with handshake + pricing?

Maria (SE): I can take this. Two quick asks: 1) do they need websocket or SSE streaming? 2) do they want enforced JSON schema for the response or just a best-effort structured output?

Alex (AE): Websocket preferred (they're embedding into a low-latency dashboard). They want strict schema validation — security/legal want deterministic outputs for audit.

Maria (SE): Got it. High level notes we usually share: streaming (ws) gives lower end-to-end latency and lets you process tokens as they arrive; structured/schema-enforced output costs the same on tokens but we recommend adding a small post-parse verification step client-side. For the POC we can enable server-side schema validation using the SDK param `response_format: "json_schema"`.

Maria (SE): Sample Node snippet we often provide (send to Horizon):

```js
// minimal streaming + function call example
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const ws = client.stream({ model: 'rw-open-1', response_format: 'json_schema', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { intent: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['intent'] } });
ws.on('open', () => ws.send({ prompt: 'Extract intent from user message', functions: [ { name: 'classify', args: ['text'] } ] }));
ws.on('message', (msg) => console.log('chunk', msg));
```

Maria (SE): Also link to the short runbook: https://redwood.docs/presales/runbooks/streaming-poc (send after permission)

Sam (SRE): Heads-up re infra/security: if they want SSO + KMS + VPC egress we need to decide Hosted vs Dedicated. Hosted supports short-lived creds + customer KMS integration for key wrapping, but for strict data residency or private-link they usually go Dedicated or Private deploy. Timeline: Hosted POC with ephemeral creds = 1-3 business days; Dedicated trial (reserved capacity) = ~2–4 weeks depending on approvals.

Sam (SRE): On the handshake: their gateway will need to send `x-rw-proxy: <client-id>` and allow TLS termination. If they have an outbound proxy we need the CA pinned or allowlist. Also recommend ephemeral creds (JWT) rotating every 15m for the POC.

Jess (PM): Security questionnaire update: Horizon flagged three enterprise blockers — (1) SAML + IdP metadata import, (2) audit logs retention and export, (3) KMS/HSM integration details. I can draft answers but need the SOC2/infra bits from infra/ops.

Alex (AE): For pricing the buyer wants a number to show finance. Can you give a ballpark per-1k-token cost and what a short reserved commit would look like?

Maria (SE): Ballpark (hosted): depends on model family and streaming vs non-streaming, but rough hosted range is 0.02–0.06 USD per 1k tokens for common open models; embeddings/large-context variants differ. Reserved/dedicated commits typically reduce unit cost by ~30–50% for predictable throughput. For a 2-week POC we usually suggest no commit (pay-as-you-go) + a small demo credit. If they plan sustained traffic>10M tokens/month then we start conversation about a dedicated seat/commit.

Sam (SRE): Another note: streaming connections don't incur a separate per-connection charge in Hosted, but long-lived connections that stay open 24/7 will accumulate token usage and connection time; we cap idle-time to protect capacity. If they need many concurrent long-lived connections, Dedicated is safer.

Maria (SE): I'll prepare a one-pager: runbook + sample SDK code + checklist (SSO/KMS/IP allowlist/VPC egress) and a tidy pricing bulleted section.

Alex (AE): Perfect. Can you also add a small test prompt set that verifies schema enforcement? Horizon legal will ask for that.

Maria (SE): Yup. I'll push a checklist and test prompts by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Deployment to presales-playground succeeded — streaming-runbook v1.2 deployed (stable) :rocket:

Jess (PM): Great — once we have the runbook + answers I'll schedule a 30m call with Horizon (Thu AM suggested).

Alex (AE): Thanks all :pray: — marking this one as high-touch.
